hypotheses.justification: The theorem takes `[NumberField L]` only because it is an instance-implicit variable and `L` is already an argument. The statement does not need it. In `Definitions/Def_AutomorphicForm_TwistedOrbital.lean`, `semiLocalIntegers` (the notation 𝒪) and `semiLocalIntegralSet` (the notation 𝒦) are declared under `variable ... [NumberField L] ...`. However, `zero_mem_semiLocalIntegers`, `one_mem_semiLocalIntegers` and `one_mem_semiLocalIntegralSet` are stated with `omit [NumberField L] in` and mention `semiLocalIntegers K L v` and `semiLocalIntegralSet K L v`. That file compiles, and `NumberField L` cannot be derived from the other instances, so neither definition takes `[NumberField L]` as an argument. The rest of the statement only needs the ring structure on `L ⊗[K] v.adicCompletion K`: the coercion `GL (Fin 2) E → Matrix` and the group inverse on units. `[NumberField K]` is still needed, because `HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)` requires `IsDedekindDomain (𝓞 K)`. So the statement still elaborates without `[NumberField L]`. The proof `Iff.rfl` only unfolds `semiLocalIntegralSet`/`integralUnitsSet` by definition and does not depend on `[NumberField L]`. So `omit [NumberField L] in theorem mem_K_iff ... := Iff.rfl` should go through unchanged.
